notes:
Summary: Mid-market product team building a discovery/ranking layer for their core SaaS. Primary objective is to evaluate Redwood Hosted rerank endpoint for A/B style relevance tuning and offline scoring pipeline. They expect to start on Hosted for fast iteration then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

POC specifics (from SE call):
- Data: ~1.2M documents (knowledge + product guides), working eval set ~10k queries with labeled relevance judgments.
- Rerank approach: candidate retrieval using existing sparse + dense pipeline; Redwood rerank endpoint to reorder top-100 candidates, goal to improve NDCG@10 by +8-12 points.
- Offline scoring: nightly bulk scoring job ~5k docs/min target, want a dedicated batch endpoint or dedicated capacity with autoscale burst for nightly window.
- Latency targets: online rerank p95 < 200ms (for 100 candidate re-rank), cost-sensitive: target <$0.03 per 1k rerank calls initially.
- Model preferences: prefer open LLaMA-family variants for cost control; open to Redwood-verified curated model if quantized.

Quotes / friction: "We need to show PMs clear delta on relevance before committing to Dedicated" — Product Lead.

Security / compliance: SSO via SAML required, audit logs must be retained 12 months, KMS support mandatory for Dedicated. Legal flagged data residency (EU customers) — asks whether Dedicated can be region-locked.

Commercial: Interested in hosted POC credits; intent to buy Dedicated if POC improves NDCG and unit economics are within forecast. Finance wants TCO estimate including committed capacity pricing and burst overhead.

Next steps (short):
- Kickoff POC week 1 on hosted rerank (setup keys, sample eval ingestion) - owner: Priya + GH eng lead.
- Run baseline eval vs Redwood rerank config A/B (3 configs) - week 2.
- Pricing call w/ AE + SE + GH finance to discuss Dedicated quotes and commitment tiers.

Stubs / links: security FAQ shared (drive), sample eval harness repo link provided in call notes (github.com/gradientharbor/eval-harness stub).
